pixel-yellow.description: Primary brand color. Dominant surface in logo, event graphics, and hero backgrounds. Optimistic and high-energy.

ink-navy.description: Primary text, keylines, borders, and structural outlines. The grounding dark that gives the palette its poster-print quality.

pixel-pink.description: High-energy accent for CTAs, selection highlights, and painted color bars. Demands attention without competing with yellow.

digital-blue.description: Technology accent. Used for pixel clusters, secondary links, and digital/tech-themed sections.

community-green.description: Growth and community accent. Used for success states, community-themed elements, and pixel clusters.

brush-orange.description: Art and creativity accent. Warm, energetic, used for pixel clusters and art-themed callouts.

coral-red.description: Error states and urgent callouts only. Not a decorative color.

canvas-cream.description: Page ground. Warm paper-like surface that lets the saturated palette pop without competing.

display.purpose: Hero h1 and major section headlines. Compact, high-contrast, slightly tightened tracking.

body.purpose: All body copy, metadata, navigation, and UI text. Open and readable at all sizes.

eyebrow.purpose: Short uppercase labels above headlines. Extrabold, tracked wide (0.18-0.2em).

shadows.name: Hard Offset
shadows.purpose: Primary card and panel shadow. Screen-print poster aesthetic. No blur.

shadows.name: Hard Offset Hover
shadows.purpose: Hover state for interactive cards. Slightly larger offset.

shadows.name: Hard Offset Small
shadows.purpose: Mobile and smaller elements. Reduced offset for tight spaces.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions. Quick entry, gentle settle.

components.name: Primary Link
components.description: Underline-accented CTA with arrow. Pink bottom border, navy text, hover lift.
components.css: .cta-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 4px solid #F2388A; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #102A43; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .cta-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .cta-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .cta-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #102A43; outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Logo Card
components.description: Bordered card with hard-offset shadow and slight rotation. Yellow background, navy border.
components.css: .logo-card { border: 3px solid #102A43; background: #FFC83D; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 12px 12px 0 0 #102A43; transform: rotate(1deg); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .logo-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(0deg); box-shadow: 16px 16px 0 0 #102A43; }

components.name: Pixel Ribbon
components.description: Vertical left-edge color bar. Five-segment gradient of brand accents with navy right border.
components.css: .pixel-ribbon { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; z-index: 20; width: 10px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #F2388A 0 20%, #248FCE 20% 40%, #36B86A 40% 60%, #FF6B35 60% 80%, #FFC83D 80% 100%); border-right: 2px solid #102A43; }

components.name: Color Swatch
components.description: Small rectangular color sample with navy border. Used in footer and brand reference.
components.html: • Pixel Yellow: #FFC83D

narrative.overview: Pixel & Paint is a joyful, poster-like design system built on saturated primary colors, hard-edge navy outlines, and screen-print-inspired shadows. The brand should feel like a hand-pulled community poster: bold, tactile, and unmistakably handmade. It is warm, energetic, and rooted in Fresno's neighborhoods.
keyCharacteristics: Saturated five-color accent palette on warm cream ground, never muted or pastel.
Hard-offset navy shadows with zero blur, evoking screen-print registration.
Strong navy keylines and borders on all major surfaces.
Pixel clusters as decorative structural elements, referencing the digital + art duality.
Slight rotations and asymmetric layouts that feel handmade, not templated.
Archivo Black for display headlines, DM Sans for everything else.

rules.name: The Yellow Is Home Rule
rules.body: Pixel Yellow is the signature brand surface. If a single color must represent Pixel & Paint, it is always yellow, never pink or blue.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Shadows use zero blur and solid navy color. No soft drop shadows, no glows, no gradients in shadows. The aesthetic is screen-print, not digital.

rules.name: The Navy Frames Everything Rule
rules.body: Major surfaces, cards, and interactive elements get a navy border (2-3px). This is the visual glue that holds the saturated palette together.

rules.name: The Pixel Cluster Rule
rules.body: Small navy-bordered colored squares arranged in offset patterns serve as the primary decorative motif. They reference both digital pixels and paint swatches.

rules.name: The Poster Rotation Rule
rules.body: Key brand elements (logo card, feature cards) may carry a 1-2 degree rotation to break grid rigidity. Hover removes the rotation for a satisfying snap-to-grid feel.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Archivo Black for display headlines only. DM Sans for everything at body size and below. Never mix them at the same scale.

rules.name: The Motion Budget Rule
rules.body: Animations are limited to 420ms max duration, 10-12px max translation, and scale(0.97) for press feedback. All motion disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

dos: Do use Pixel Yellow as the dominant brand surface.
Do use hard-offset navy shadows on cards and panels.
Do frame major elements with 2-3px navy borders.
Do use pixel clusters as structural decoration.
Do keep headlines short, active, and plainspoken.
Do show real community photos over stock imagery.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for all animation.
Do maintain WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on all text.
Do use the five-color ribbon as a consistent brand marker.
donts: Do not use gradients as fills (only in the ribbon structure).
Do not use muted, pastel, or earth-tone versions of the palette.
Do not use serif or script typefaces.
Do not use glassmorphism, frosted panels, or translucent overlays.
Do not use stock photography of generic children.
Do not use rounded corners larger than 2px.
Do not use pure black (#000) — always use Ink Navy.
Do not use the coral red for anything other than errors or urgent states.
